title: RHEL Patch and Health Validation Playbook
description: Updates all packages on a RHEL managed host, reboots, and validates memory, disk space, and running services both before and after the update, producing a comprehensive result report.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: target_server
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the RHEL managed host to patch.

parameters.name: min_free_memory_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free memory required before and after patching. Recommended: 2.

parameters.name: fs_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of mount points to exclude from free disk space checks.

parameters.name: min_free_disk_gb
parameters.description: Minimum free disk space (in GB) required per filesystem not in the exclude list. Recommended: 5.

parameters.name: fs_type_exclude_list
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of filesystem types to exclude from free disk space checks.

parameters.name: reboot_timeout
parameters.description: Maximum time to wait for the server to come back online after reboot. Recommended: 600.

playbook_output.description: Structured status report of pre- and post-update checks, update, and reboot.

fields.name: pre_mem_ok
fields.description: True if pre-update free memory was at or above the minimum threshold.

fields.name: pre_disk_ok
fields.description: True if all pre-update checked filesystems had sufficient free space.

fields.name: update_ok
fields.description: True if the package update step succeeded.

fields.name: reboot_ok
fields.description: True if the reboot succeeded and the host came back online within the timeout.

fields.name: post_mem_ok
fields.description: True if post-update free memory was at or above the minimum threshold.

fields.name: post_disk_ok
fields.description: True if all post-update checked filesystems had sufficient free space.

fields.name: services_match
fields.description: True if the set of running services after reboot matches the pre-update set.

fields.name: mismatch_services
fields.description: Names of services that differ between pre- and post-update running sets.

fields.name: pre_disk_issues
fields.description: List of mount points with insufficient free space before the update.

fields.name: post_disk_issues
fields.description: List of mount points with insufficient free space after the update.

steps.name: Gather pre-update memory facts
steps.function: Collect memory facts from the target host using the setup module with the memory subset.

steps.name: Check pre-update memory threshold
steps.function: Branch on whether the available free memory is below the configured minimum.
steps.condition: Free memory (in MB) is below the minimum threshold (min_free_memory_gb GB).

steps.name: Fail due to insufficient pre-update memory
steps.function: Immediately fail the playbook with an appropriate message because pre-update memory is too low.

steps.name: Record pre-update memory check passed
steps.function: Set a flag indicating the pre-update memory check passed.

steps.name: Gather pre-update mount facts
steps.function: Collect filesystem mount facts using the setup module with the mounts subset.

steps.name: Compute pre-update disk issues
steps.function: Filter mount facts by excluded mount points and filesystem types, then identify those with free space below the minimum threshold.

computations._pre_disk_issues: Parse _ansible_mounts_pre, exclude entries whose mount is listed in fs_exclude_list (split by comma) or whose fstype is in fs_type_exclude_list (split by comma). Keep entries where size_available < min_free_disk_gb * 1073741824. Store as a list of strings (mount points).
computations._pre_disk_ok: True if _pre_disk_issues is empty, false otherwise.

steps.name: Check pre-update disk space
steps.function: Branch on whether any filesystem has insufficient free space before the update.
steps.condition: Pre-update disk check found one or more filesystems with insufficient free space.

steps.name: Fail due to insufficient pre-update disk space
steps.function: Immediately fail the playbook because one or more filesystems lack the required free space.

steps.name: Record pre-update disk check passed
steps.function: Set a flag indicating the pre-update disk space check passed.

steps.name: Gather pre-update service facts
steps.function: Collect facts about systemd services using the service_facts module.

steps.name: Extract running services pre-update
steps.function: Build a list of service names that are in the running state from the pre-update service facts.

computations._pre_services: Filter _ansible_services_pre.ansible_facts.services to entries where state is 'running', then collect the keys as a sorted list.

steps.name: Update all packages
steps.function: Install all available package updates using the dnf module.

steps.name: Reboot the server
steps.function: Reboot the target host and wait for it to come back online within the configured timeout.

steps.name: Gather post-update memory facts
steps.function: Collect memory facts after the update and reboot.

steps.name: Check post-update memory threshold
steps.function: Compare post-update free memory against the minimum threshold and record the result.

steps.name: Gather post-update mount facts
steps.function: Collect mount facts after the update and reboot.

steps.name: Compute post-update disk issues
steps.function: Filter post-update mount facts using the same exclusion rules and threshold, recording any filesystems with insufficient space.

computations._post_disk_issues: Parse _ansible_mounts_post, exclude by fs_exclude_list and fs_type_exclude_list. Keep mount points where size_available < min_free_disk_gb * 1073741824. List of mount strings.
computations._post_disk_ok: True if _post_disk_issues is empty, else false.

steps.name: Gather post-update service facts
steps.function: Collect systemd service facts after reboot.

steps.name: Compare running services
steps.function: Build the post-update running service list, compare with the pre-update list, and flag any differences.

computations._post_services: Filter _ansible_services_post.ansible_facts.services to running entries, get sorted list of names.
computations._mismatch_services: List of service names present in one list but not the other.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the final structured report containing all pre/post statuses, update/reboot results, and mismatch details.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Validate pre-update memory, disk space, and capture baseline running services before any changes.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Apply all package updates and reboot the target host.

phases.name: Post-checks
phases.description: Verify post-update memory, disk space, and service continuity.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final status report.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Handles any task failure by printing an error message and stopping the playbook.
